svg.title: Tech stack, as a periodic table
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, HTML5, CSS; Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind, Vite; Backend: Node.js, Express, Django, FastAPI, Socket.io, JWT; Data & queues: MongoDB, Postgres, Redis, Supabase, BullMQ, Streams; AI / ML: Gemini, GPT-4o, RAG, Retell AI, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, YOLOv5; DevOps & QA: Docker, NGINX, AWS S3, Vercel, GH Actions, Jest, Playwright, SonarQube, Puppeteer
